name: display
description: Sets an element's inner and outer display types.
code: div { display: block; }\nspan { display: inline; }\n.flex-container { display: flex; }

name: position
description: Specifies the type of positioning method used for an element (static, relative, absolute, fixed, or sticky).

name: top, right, bottom, left
description: Specifies the position of a positioned element.

name: float
description: Places an element on the left or right side of its container, allowing text and inline elements to wrap around it.

name: clear
description: Controls the flow of content before/after an element with the float property.

name: z-index
description: Specifies the stack order of a positioned element.

name: overflow
description: Specifies what should happen if content overflows an element's box.

name: visibility
description: Specifies whether an element is visible or hidden.

name: width
description: Sets the width of an element.

name: height
description: Sets the height of an element.

name: margin
description: Sets the margin area on all four sides of an element.

name: padding
description: Sets the padding area on all four sides of an element.

name: border
description: A shorthand property for setting the individual border properties.

name: box-sizing
description: Tells the browser what the sizing properties (width and height) should include.

name: min-width
description: Sets the minimum width of an element.

name: max-width
description: Sets the maximum width of an element.

name: min-height
description: Sets the minimum height of an element.

name: max-height
description: Sets the maximum height of an element.

name: flex-direction
description: Establishes the main-axis, thus defining the direction flex items are placed in the flex container.

name: flex-wrap
description: Allows flex items to wrap onto multiple lines or columns.

name: justify-content
description: Defines the alignment along the main axis.

name: align-items
description: Defines the default behavior for how flex items are laid out along the cross axis.

name: align-content
description: Aligns a flex container's lines within when there is extra space in the cross-axis.

name: flex-grow
description: Defines the ability for a flex item to grow if necessary.

name: flex-shrink
description: Defines the ability for a flex item to shrink if necessary.

name: flex-basis
description: Defines the default size of an element before the remaining space is distributed.

name: flex
description: A shorthand for flex-grow, flex-shrink and flex-basis.

name: order
description: Controls the order in which flex items appear in the flex container.

name: grid-template-columns
description: Defines the columns of the grid.

name: grid-template-rows
description: Defines the rows of the grid.

name: grid-gap
description: A shorthand for grid-row-gap and grid-column-gap.

name: grid-column
description: Specifies a grid item’s size and location in a grid layout.

name: grid-row
description: Specifies a grid item’s size and location in a grid layout.

name: grid-area
description: A shorthand for grid-row-start, grid-column-start, grid-row-end and grid-column-end.

name: justify-items
description: Aligns grid items along the inline (row) axis.

name: color
description: Sets the color of text.

name: font-family
description: Specifies the font for an element.

name: font-size
description: Sets the size of the font.

name: font-weight
description: Sets how thick or thin characters in text should be displayed.

name: font-style
description: Sets the style of the font.

name: line-height
description: Specifies the height of a line.

name: text-align
description: Specifies the horizontal alignment of text.

name: text-decoration
description: Specifies the decoration added to text.

name: text-transform
description: Controls the capitalization of text.

name: letter-spacing
description: Increases or decreases the space between characters in a text.

name: word-spacing
description: Increases or decreases the white space between words.

name: white-space
description: Specifies how white-space inside an element is handled.

name: text-shadow
description: Adds shadow to text.

name: background-color
description: Sets the background color of an element.

name: background-image
description: Sets one or more background images for an element.

name: background-repeat
description: Sets if/how a background image will be repeated.

name: background-position
description: Sets the starting position of a background image.

name: background-size
description: Specifies the size of the background images.

name: background-attachment
description: Sets whether a background image scrolls with the rest of the page, or is fixed.

name: background
description: A shorthand property for all the background properties.
code: body { background: #ffffff url("img.png") no-repeat right top; }

name: border-width
description: Sets the width of an element's four borders.

name: border-style
description: Sets the style of an element's four borders.

name: border-color
description: Sets the color of an element's four borders.

name: border-radius
description: Rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge.

name: transition
description: A shorthand property for setting the four transition properties.

name: transition-property
description: Specifies the name of the CSS property the transition effect is for.

name: transition-duration
description: Specifies how many seconds or milliseconds a transition effect takes to complete.

name: transition-timing-function
description: Specifies the speed curve of the transition effect.

name: transition-delay
description: Specifies a delay (in seconds) for the transition effect.

name: animation
description: A shorthand property for all the animation properties.
code: @keyframes example { from {background-color: red;} to {background-color: yellow;} }\ndiv { animation: example 5s; }

name: animation-name
description: Specifies the name of the @keyframes animation.

name: animation-duration
description: Specifies how long an animation should take to complete one cycle.

name: animation-iteration-count
description: Specifies the number of times an animation should be played.

name: transform
description: Applies a 2D or 3D transformation to an element.

name: transform-origin
description: Allows you to change the position of transformed elements.

name: transform-style
description: Specifies how nested elements are rendered in 3D space.

name: opacity
description: Sets the opacity level for an element.

name: box-shadow
description: Attaches one or more shadows to an element.

name: cursor
description: Specifies the mouse cursor to be displayed when pointing over an element.

name: list-style-type
description: Specifies the type of list-item marker.

name: user-select
description: Controls whether the user can select text.

name: clip-path
description: Creates a clipping region that sets what part of an element is visible.

name: filter
description: Defines effects (e.g., blurring or color shifting) on an element before the element is displayed.

name: object-fit
description: Specifies how the contents of a replaced element should be fitted to the container's height and width.

name: outline
description: An outline is a line drawn around elements, outside the borders, to make the element "stand out".

name: resize
description: Defines if (and how) an element is resizable by the user.

name: align-self
description: Specifies the alignment for a single flex item, overriding the container's align-items property.

name: backface-visibility
description: Defines whether or not the back face of an element should be visible when facing the user.

name: border-collapse
description: Sets whether table borders should collapse into a single border or be separated.

name: border-spacing
description: Sets the distance between the borders of adjacent cells in a table.

name: caption-side
description: Specifies the placement of a table caption.

name: empty-cells
description: Sets whether or not to display borders and background on empty cells in a table.

name: table-layout
description: Defines the algorithm used to lay out table cells, rows, and columns.

name: text-overflow
description: Specifies how overflowed content that is not displayed should be signaled to the user.

name: word-break
description: Specifies how words should break when reaching the end of a line.

name: word-wrap
description: Alias for overflow-wrap. Specifies whether or not the browser may break lines within words in order to prevent overflow.

name: writing-mode
description: Sets whether lines of text are laid out horizontally or vertically.

name: perspective
description: Gives a 3D-positioned element some perspective.

name: perspective-origin
description: Defines at which position the user is looking at the 3D-positioned element.

name: content
description: Used with the ::before and ::after pseudo-elements, to insert generated content.

name: quotes
description: Sets the type of quotation marks for embedded quotations.

name: counter-reset
description: Creates or resets one or more CSS counters.

name: counter-increment
description: Increments one or more CSS counters by a given value.

name: list-style
description: A shorthand for list-style-type, list-style-position, and list-style-image.

name: list-style-position
description: Specifies the position of the list-item markers.

name: list-style-image
description: Specifies an image as the list-item marker.

name: font-variant
description: Specifies whether or not a text should be displayed in a small-caps font.

name: font-stretch
description: Selects a normal, condensed, or expanded face from a font.

name: text-justify
description: Specifies the justification method of text when text-align is set to "justify".

name: text-indent
description: Specifies the indentation of the first line in a text-block.

name: text-decoration-line
description: Specifies the type of line in a text-decoration.

name: text-decoration-color
description: Specifies the color of the text-decoration.

name: text-decoration-style
description: Specifies the style of the line in a text-decoration.

name: caret-color
description: Specifies the color of the cursor (caret) in inputs, textareas, or any element that is editable.

name: background-blend-mode
description: Specifies the blending mode of each background layer (color and/or image).
code: div { background-image: url(bg.jpg); background-color: red; background-blend-mode: multiply; }

name: mix-blend-mode
description: Specifies how an element's content should blend with the content of the element's parent and the element's background.

name: isolation
description: Defines whether an element must create a new stacking context.

name: scroll-behavior
description: Specifies whether to smoothly animate the scroll position, instead of a straight jump, when the user clicks on a link that targets an anchor on the same page.

name: scroll-snap-type
description: Specifies how strictly snap points are enforced on the scroll container.

name: scroll-snap-align
description: Specifies the snap position of a snap container's children.

name: shape-outside
description: Defines a shape. The inline content will wrap around this shape.

name: shape-margin
description: Adds a margin to a shape-outside.

name: grid-auto-flow
description: Controls how the auto-placement algorithm works, specifying exactly how auto-placed items get flowed into the grid.

name: grid-auto-columns
description: Specifies the size of any auto-generated grid columns.

name: grid-auto-rows
description: Specifies the size of any auto-generated grid rows.

name: column-count
description: Specifies the number of columns an element should be divided into.

name: column-gap
description: Specifies the gap between the columns.

name: column-rule
description: A shorthand property for setting all the column-rule-* properties.

name: column-span
description: Specifies how many columns an element should span across.

name: column-width
description: Specifies a suggested, optimal width for the columns.

name: flex-flow
description: A shorthand property for the flex-direction and flex-wrap properties.

name: margin-top
description: Sets the top margin of an element.

name: margin-right
description: Sets the right margin of an element.

name: margin-bottom
description: Sets the bottom margin of an element.

name: margin-left
description: Sets the left margin of an element.

name: padding-top
description: Sets the top padding of an element.

name: padding-right
description: Sets the right padding of an element.

name: padding-bottom
description: Sets the bottom padding of an element.

name: padding-left
description: Sets the left padding of an element.

name: border-top
description: A shorthand property for setting all the properties for the top border.

name: border-right
description: A shorthand property for setting all the properties for the right border.

name: border-bottom
description: A shorthand property for setting all the properties for the bottom border.

name: border-left
description: A shorthand property for setting all the properties for the left border.

name: border-top-left-radius
description: Defines the radius of the top-left corner.

name: border-top-right-radius
description: Defines the radius of the top-right corner.

name: border-bottom-right-radius
description: Defines the radius of the bottom-right corner.

name: border-bottom-left-radius
description: Defines the radius of the bottom-left corner.

name: animation-delay
description: Specifies a delay for the start of an animation.

name: animation-direction
description: Specifies whether an animation should be played forwards, backwards or in alternate cycles.

name: animation-fill-mode
description: Specifies a style for the element when the animation is not playing (before it starts, after it ends, or both).

name: animation-play-state
description: Specifies whether the animation is running or paused.

name: animation-timing-function
description: Specifies the speed curve of an animation.

name: font
description: A shorthand property for font-style, font-variant, font-weight, font-size/line-height, and font-family.
code: p { font: italic small-caps bold 16px/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; }

name: overflow-x
description: Specifies whether to clip the content, add a scroll bar, or display overflow content of a block-level element, when it overflows at the left and right edges.

name: overflow-y
description: Specifies whether to clip the content, add a scroll bar, or display overflow content of a block-level element, when it overflows at the top and bottom edges.

name: pointer-events
description: Defines whether or not an element reacts to pointer events.

name: accent-color
description: Sets the accent color for user-interface controls.

name: appearance
description: Controls the native appearance of UI controls.

name: background-origin
description: Specifies the origin position of a background image.

name: background-clip
description: Specifies the painting area of the background.

name: color-scheme
description: Allows an element to indicate which color schemes it can comfortably be rendered in.

name: font-kerning
description: Controls the usage of the kerning information stored in a font.

name: font-optical-sizing
description: Allows developers to control whether browsers render text with optical sizing.

name: hyphens
description: Specifies how to split words to improve the layout of paragraphs.

name: line-break
description: Specifies how to break lines of text.

name: orphans
description: Specifies the minimum number of lines in a block container that must be left at the bottom of a page.

name: widows
description: Specifies the minimum number of lines in a block container that must be shown at the top of a page.

name: text-rendering
description: Provides a hint to the browser about what aspects of text rendering to optimize for.

name: text-size-adjust
description: Controls the text inflation algorithm used on some smartphones and tablets.

name: user-zoom
description: Controls whether the user can change the zoom level of the document.

name: will-change
description: Hints to browsers how an element is expected to change.
